description: Create a new skill at a workspace path. Content is the full SKILL.md body (frontmatter + markdown). For github_ref skills set source='github_ref' and github_url. Cloud-only: does NOT materialize the skill into .codex/skills, .claude/skills, .cursor/skills, etc. — Pathrule Studio or CLI is required for on-disk skill materialization.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content including frontmatter and markdown.

description.description: Short summary of when agents should use this skill. Use null only if unknown.

github_url.description: Canonical GitHub URL for github_ref skills; null or omit for manual/template skills.

node_path.description: Workspace-relative path where the skill should be offered, e.g. / or /packages/app.

source.description: Skill source type. Use github_ref only when github_url points to the canonical skill source.

tags.description: Optional discovery tags such as frontend, database, or release.

name: pathrule_write_skill

data.description: Created skill: id, name, node_id, node_path, version_id.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

human_message.description: One-line summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

title: Pathrule Write Skill
